# test name | pass or fail | regex the failure message must match (fail only)
withinBudget|pass|
overBudget|fail|ran 8 .*budget 5
nPlusOne|fail|ran 10 .*budget 3(.|\n)*10x
unlimited|pass|
ownFailure|fail|the test's own failure
withinClassBudget|pass|
methodOverridesClass|pass|
overClassBudget|fail|ran 10 .*budget 2
inheritsOuterBudget|fail|ran 10 .*budget 2
